sara: Quick sync 50m sprint tomorrow to finalize Hosted / Dedicated / Private hero lines + webinar landing + inbound routing. outcome: ship 2 hero variants + HubSpot routing doc.

leo: +1. suggest one PLG hero and one benchmark hero for Hosted.

anya: i'll attach a tiny benchmark one-pager showing batching impact and a couple of customer quotes.

matt: will draft the HubSpot fields: Use case, Team size, Compliance checkbox, Expected RPS. routing rule: team_size>50 OR compliance=true -> enterprise-sales; use_case==evaluation -> webinar nurture; else -> demo queue. will add utm_campaign=tri_mode_site.

julia: timeboxes: 20m hero, 30m body/proofs, 20m webinar landing, 15m routing, 5m wrap.

sara: pre-read due today 5pm PT. owners: leo (heroes + launch angles), anya (benchmarks), matt (routing + tracking), julia (facilitate).

leo: quick hero drafts:
Hosted A: "Start in minutes 1 production-grade inference"
Hosted B: "Instant LLM features  no infra"
Dedicated A: "Reserved capacity  SLA-backed throughput"
Dedicated B: "Predictable throughput  lower unit cost at scale"
Private A: "Run inference in your VPC  enterprise controls"
Private B: "Air-gapped serving  total data custody"

sara: nice. we'll iterate tomorrow and aim to finalize by Friday for the launch post and webinar invite. :rocket:
